author: Ari Koslow
title: Matthew Boyd 'feels good' after rehab outing Saturday
desc: Matthew Boyd told reporters he "feels good" after his rehab outing on Saturday.
impact: Boyd threw 60 pitches in the outing. There should be an update on next steps for him later in the week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Wilber Dotel (lat) throws bullpen Sunday
desc: Wilber Dotel threw a bullpen session on Sunday.
impact: Dotel was placed on the injured list last week. He'll look to get cleared to face live hitters next.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Hunter Barco (elbow/triceps) to see team doctors Monday
desc: Hunter Barco is scheduled to visit team doctors with the Pirates on Monday.
impact: Barco is dealing with a elbow/triceps issue. There should be an update provided on his status in the upcoming days.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Oneil Cruz (hand) to be re-evaluated Monday
desc: Oneil Cruz will be re-evaluated on Monday.
impact: Cruz and the team will decide on next steps at that point. There should be an update on a potential timeline in the upcoming days.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Blake Treinen (elbow) undergoes MRI
desc: Blake Treinen underwent an MRI that did not reveal any structural damage.
impact: Treinen could end up requiring a minimum stint on the injured list.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Khal Stephen (elbow) undergoes season-ending surgery
desc: Guardians pitching prospect Khal Stephen is scheduled to undergo season-ending elbow surgery.
impact: Stephen will figure to miss time into next season as well. He was acquired by Cleveland in the Shane Bieber trade.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Sammy Peralta designated for assignment
desc: The Rockies designated LHP Sammy Peralta for assignment.
impact: Peralta loses his spot on the Rockies 40-man roster following his struggles. He will likely pass through waivers unclaimed.

author: Ari Koslow
title: John Brebbia has contract selected by Rockies
desc: The Rockies selected the contract of RHP John Brebbia from Triple-A Albuquerque.
impact: Brebbia recently signed a minor league contract with Colorado. He will now get an opportunity in the majors with them.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kohl Drake to work in long relief role
desc: Diamondbacks manager Torey Lovullo said Kohl Drake will work in a long relief role out of the bullpen.
impact: Drake was recalled from Triple-A on Sunday. He will add a fresh arm in their bullpen.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jordan Montgomery (elbow) sent on rehab assignment
desc: The Rangers sent Jordan Montgomery on a rehab assignment to Double-A Frisco.
impact: Montgomery is scheduled to make his first rehab start on Sunday. He is working his way back from Tommy John surgery.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Konnor Griffin (forearm) nearing rehab assignment
desc: Pirates GM Ben Cherington said Sunday that he expects Konnor Griffin to play in rehab games by the end of the week, "barring something unforeseen."
impact: Griffin has been rehabbing in Florida since he landed on the injured list at the end of May. He could be on track to return in early July.

author: Ari Koslow
title: George Valera sent outright by Guardians
desc: The Guardians sent George Valera outright to Triple-A Columbus.
impact: Valera passed through waivers unclaimed after he was designated for assignment. He will remain in the Guardians organization.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dean Kremer (quad) throws 66 pitches in rehab start Sunday
desc: Dean Kremer threw 66 pitches in his first rehab start on Sunday.
impact: Kremer allowed one run on two hits over 3 2/3 innings with five strikeouts and two walks. He'll figure to require at least a couple more outings on his rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Corey Seager (concussion) takes part in defensive drills Sunday
desc: Corey Seager took part in defensive drills on the field on Sunday.
impact: Seager is expected to travel with the Rangers during their upcoming 10-game road swing. He'll have a chance to be activated from the concussion injured list during that span.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Will Smith (neck) hopeful to be activated by early July
desc: Will Smith is hopeful to be activated from the injured list in early July.
impact: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Smith will not be activated for the team's 10-day road trip. He added that a potential rehab assignment for Smith will be decided based on his progress while the team is away.
